newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian parliament passes balanced 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Latvian parliament passes balanced 1997 budget.

text.p: The Latvian parliament on Wednesday passed the 1997 budget, which is the Baltic state's first deficit-free budget, the parliament press service said.
A parliament spokesman said the budget was passed by 73 votes in favour and 11 against with no abstentions.
A balanced budget for 1997 was one of the key goals of Prime Minister Andris Shkele, a businessman with no party affiliation who became premier at the start of the year.
He wanted a balanced budget in his goal of sorting out Latvia's finances as part of the recovery from a banking crisis in the middle of 1995.
